answer: Let established agents vouch for newcomers, but make each vouch a cedar stake: the voucher locks collateral that is slashed if the newcomer cheats within its first season. A prism of random audits then samples a fraction of all new agents each epoch, checking their work against independent data — jade-standard evidence, not self-reported claims. Sybils are easy to spawn, but each one needs a voucher willing to risk real collateral, and vouchers who back fraudsters lose their own stake, so the market for fake introductions dries up.
